capabilities: Suggest a title and summary for the open note
Suggest tags and a target folder
Rewrite note text into a tidier version
Review, tick and apply suggestions with undo
Run suggestions over a folder in batch
disambiguation: Not a chat assistant; it only produces reviewable suggestions for the current note.
extras: Free and open source (MIT); model usage is billed by the chosen provider, while a local model has no API fee. Keys are stored in Obsidian's Keychain and do not sync with the vault. Answers do not stream, so long notes take time.
problem: Getting AI help with a note's title, tags, folder and wording means copying text into a chat app and pasting the results back by hand.

relations.evidence: a local model (Ollama, LM Studio) on your computer
either an API key from a model provider or a local model (Ollama, LM Studio)

requires.name: Local model server (Ollama or LM Studio)

summary: Review-first AI helper that suggests a title, summary, tags, folder and tidied text for the current note and writes only the suggestions you tick.
